definition: ἀπο-δείκνυμι  [in LXX: Est.2:9 (רָאָה), al. ;] __1. to bring out, show forth, exhibit (Lft., Notes, 200; ICC, in l): 1Co.4:9.  __2. to declare, show: Act.2:22  __3. to prove: Act.25:7.  __4. As frequently in late Gk., to proclaim to an office: before ὅτι, 2Th.2:4 (Milligan, in l; MM, see word; Lft., Notes. 113.)† (AS)
